formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P16-R3 — Fixed-Rank Raw Exact-State Latent vs Handcrafted Search-Coordinate Policy Representation Tournament, Stage-Held-Out Cross-Cohort Likelihood, Equal-Rank Capacity Control, Representation-Specific Information Gain, Metadata Firewall & Fresh-Confirmation Qualification Tournament

HANDCRAFTED_SEARCH.optimizer: same deterministic full-softmax SGD as R2

development_reservoir: same P11/P13/P14/P15 unique296 reservoir as R2

validation.folds: leave one full stage out: P11/P13/P14/P15
validation.LATENT_DOMINANCE_DEVELOPMENT: latent wins >=3/4 stages AND mean(HAND NLL - RAW NLL)>0
validation.HANDCRAFTED_DOMINANCE_DEVELOPMENT: handcrafted wins >=3/4 stages AND mean(RAW NLL - HAND NLL)>0

boundaries: All data are prior-contacted development evidence.
Equal latent rank does not make the feature spaces causally comparable; it is a capacity-control convenience.
A development winner only qualifies a representation for frozen fresh confirmation.
No latent dimension or handcrafted coordinate is promoted to a human cognitive mechanism.
